issues.description: RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings is specified as type int in the UML/problem statement, but the reference solution declares the field as long and the getter getNumberOfLoopings() returns long. Students following the UML will implement an int field and int-returning getter, which conflicts with the reference solution's type expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the UML by changing RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings to int and changing getNumberOfLoopings() to return int (alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to specify long if that is intended).
